subject: English 1st Paper (English For Today)
topic: Column Matching (Question No. 8: Matching sentences from Column A, B & C)
book: Original practice; user-provided Class 8 Model Tests

items.text:
Match one part from each column to make five meaningful sentences. Use each part once.

Topic: School library

Column A:
a) A librarian
b) A borrower
c) A dictionary
d) A reading room
e) A library card

Column B:
1) explains
2) arranges
3) returns
4) identifies
5) provides

Column C:
i) a book on its due date
j) a quiet place to read
k) a registered borrower
l) books on shelves
m) the meanings of words
items.explanation:
a) 2 – l: A librarian arranges books on shelves.
b) 3 – i: A borrower returns a book on its due date.
c) 1 – m: A dictionary explains the meanings of words.
d) 5 – j: A reading room provides a quiet place to read.
e) 4 – k: A library card identifies a registered borrower.
